text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through the Twinkle Series
with my partner Umamusume would begin.
The name of the girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
You're super lucky!
I can win without even lifting a finger,
so GⅠ races will probably be a piece of cake♪

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
S-o-o, no being strict, okay?
Let's just keep things chill and fun, deal?♡

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our challenge for the Twinkle Series
with <chrname> began!
